newsitem.title: USA: Partnership holds 6.1 pct Hi-Lo stake.
newsitem.headline: Partnership holds 6.1 pct Hi-Lo stake.

text.p: Hwang Family Ltd Partnership said Monday it holds a 6.1 percent stake in Hi-Lo Automotive Inc or 654,800 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the partnership said the stake includes 618,200 common shares bought between July 22 and Aug 30 at $3.25 to $3.75 a share.

The partnership said it believes the common stock is "grossly" underpriced and it bought the stock with the belief shareholder values can be enhanced by prodding Hi-Lo to improve its operations or put it up for sale.
The partnership intends to seek cooperation of other major shareholders, the filing said.
